human_in_loop_decisions: Every adverse recommendation, near-threshold application and appeal requires a reviewer with the evidence, time and authority to override, pause or escalate.
strongest_guardrails: No automatic rejection; job-relevant feature policy; subgroup evaluation; complete audit and appeal records; manual fallback; vendor data minimization and stop thresholds.
cross_industry_pattern: Across the HR cases and this product boundary, model performance alone cannot prevent employment harm: data, rules, UX, vendor processing and accountability must become release gates before scale increases.
